items.headline: Manchester United complete summer transfers with 7 signings, 24 departures
items.summary: Transfer window closes with Manchester United signing 7 players and parting with 24 via loans, transfers and expiring contracts

items.headline: Rasmus Hojlund completes permanent move to Napoli for £43m
items.summary: Danish striker Rasmus Hojlund joins Napoli permanently after loan spell, with move triggered by Napoli's Champions League qualification

items.headline: Carlos Baleba completes Manchester United transfer from Brighton
items.summary: Midfielder Carlos Baleba signed from Brighton for £65m plus £5m add-ons to complete United's midfield rebuild

items.headline: Casemiro departs Manchester United as free agent
items.summary: Brazilian midfielder Casemiro left Manchester United at end of contract following the 2025-26 season

items.headline: Jadon Sancho and Tyrell Malacia exit Manchester United
items.summary: England winger Jadon Sancho and left-back Tyrell Malacia both depart Old Trafford in the summer transfer window
